comments.content: The lv_anim_set_values call uses (int32_t)num as the end value, but animation values are typically 0-based indices. For a 3-frame animation, valid indices are 0, 1, 2. Setting end value to 3 would cause an out-of-bounds access when the animation reaches the end value. Should be (int32_t)num - 1.
Same off-by-one issue: lv_anim_set_values uses (int32_t)num as start value for reverse playback. For 3 frames, valid indices are 0, 1, 2. Starting at 3 is out of bounds. Should be (int32_t)num - 1.
